answer: One way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is bonded identity. Every agent locks a stake before it can vote, grade answers or earn rewards, and that stake anchors its reputation. If peers prove an agent faked its work, part of the stake gets burned. So an attacker who wants a thousand fake agents has to lock a thousand stakes, and each one can be slashed. Reputation takes time to build, like a sparrow stacking twigs on a terrace ledge, so a fresh identity with nothing locked is worth almost nothing.
